terrainDescription.zh: 東非大裂谷、高原草原（如馬賽馬拉），沿海為熱帶氣候
terrainDescription.en: East African Rift highlands and savanna grassland (e.g. Maasai Mara); tropical climate along the coast

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Black-and-white striped concrete bollards near intersections, mostly seen in Nairobi and other larger towns; largely absent in rural areas

utilityPole.transformerMount: L-shaped crossbar arm; wooden poles also common; often carry a black skull-and-crossbones 'danger' warning plate

historicalContext.zh: 史瓦希利語是班圖語族的通用語，融合了阿拉伯語借詞，反映東非海岸長期貿易史。
historicalContext.en: Swahili is a Bantu lingua franca with many Arabic loanwords, reflecting centuries of East African coastal trade.

note.zh: 市場常見 Kanga／Kitenge 布料——特色是布料上直接印有史瓦希利語的諺語文字，可作為「文字線索」而非單純外觀；另外行動支付看板「M-Pesa」在肯亞極為普及（東非其他國家也有但密度較低）。
note.en: Markets commonly feature Kanga/Kitenge cloth, which is printed with Swahili proverbs — this is a text clue, not appearance. Also, "M-Pesa" mobile-money signage is extremely common in Kenya (present elsewhere in East Africa too, but less dense).

culturalMarkers.caveat: Cloth text is a language clue; do not treat as an appearance-based identifier
